headline: Two teenage girls killed in hit-and-run in Dhaka's Shyamoli
summary: The victims, both under 18, were run over by a truck while crossing the road beneath a footbridge on Friday morning.
details: Two teenage girls died after being run over by a truck while crossing a road in Dhaka's Shyamoli intersection around 5:30 am on Friday.
One of the girls died instantly at the scene, while the other was rushed to Shaheed Suhrawardy Medical College Hospital, where she later succumbed to her injuries.
According to Mohammadpur Police Station Sub-Inspector Md Johnny, the truck sped away immediately after the collision, making it a hit-and-run incident.
Police have not yet established the identities of both victims, although one of the girls managed to provide her name as Mukta before passing away.
Authorities are currently searching for the truck involved in the accident, but have been unable to locate the vehicle so far.
caption:
Two teenage girls, both under 18, were killed in a hit-and-run truck accident in Dhaka's Shyamoli.

Two teenage girls died after being run over by a truck while crossing a road in Dhaka's Shyamoli intersection around 5:30 am on Friday.

One of the girls died instantly at the scene, while the other was rushed to Shaheed Suhrawardy Medical College Hospital, where she later succumbed to her injuries.

According to Mohammadpur Police Station Sub-Inspector Md Johnny, the truck sped away immediately after the collision, making it a hit-and-run incident.

Police have not yet established the identities of both victims, although one of the girls managed to provide her name as Mukta before passing away.

Authorities are currently searching for the truck involved in the accident, but have been unable to locate the vehicle so far.

headline_marked: Saudi Arabia [[executes 2 Bangladeshis]] for ‘immoral act’ in Makkah mosque
headline: Saudi Arabia executes 2 Bangladeshis for ‘immoral act’ in Makkah mosque
summary: The individuals were sentenced to death under ta’zir, a discretionary punishment under Islamic law, for violating the sanctity of the location.
details: Saudi Arabia executed two Bangladeshi nationals, Nazerul Islam Abdul Basir and Siti Akhtar, on October 14 in the Makkah region.
The pair were convicted of committing an 'immoral act' inside a mosque in Makkah, according to a statement from the Saudi Ministry of Interior.
The court sentenced them to death under ta’zir, a form of discretionary punishment under Islamic law, citing the gravity of the offence and the violation of the sanctity of the time and place.
The Bangladesh Consulate General in Jeddah stated that they were not notified of the executions beforehand by the Saudi Ministry.
Following the execution, the consulate has submitted a note verbale to the Saudi Ministry of Foreign Affairs requesting formal acknowledgement of the matter.
caption:
Two Bangladeshis were executed in Saudi Arabia for an 'immoral act' inside a mosque in Makkah.

Saudi Arabia executed two Bangladeshi nationals, Nazerul Islam Abdul Basir and Siti Akhtar, on October 14 in the Makkah region.

The pair were convicted of committing an 'immoral act' inside a mosque in Makkah, according to a statement from the Saudi Ministry of Interior.

The court sentenced them to death under ta’zir, a form of discretionary punishment under Islamic law, citing the gravity of the offence and the violation of the sanctity of the time and place.

The Bangladesh Consulate General in Jeddah stated that they were not notified of the executions beforehand by the Saudi Ministry.

Following the execution, the consulate has submitted a note verbale to the Saudi Ministry of Foreign Affairs requesting formal acknowledgement of the matter.

Source: Prothom Alo, The Daily Star
